profile_name: YouTube findings OFF — now the shipped default
description: Control arm for the 2026-08-06 YouTube-corpus A/B. As of that date this arm matches the SHIPPED DEFAULTS: the five behavioural weights were set to neutral in AIDecisionMaker after the mirror-match head-to-head measured -2.05 VP/game (95% CI [-7.2, +3.1], record 6-12-2) and the earlier asymmetric A/B measured +3.0 VP — two estimates straddling zero. Keeping this file is still useful: it also pins DEEP_STRIKE_DENIAL_RANGE_PX back to the legacy 9" that F007 replaced with a derivation, which the shipped default does NOT do (the 8" fix ships on, being a rules correction rather than a behaviour change). Use it to reproduce the pre-change AI wholesale.
